project.name: Dashboard UX Sprint B — Advanced Visualisations & Analytical Depth

summary: Sprint B completes the dashboard UX uplift with four areas: (1) Recommendations page overhaul — lever summary strip with visual savings breakdown chart and a priority matrix scatter replacing the tabs-only navigation; (2) Data Quality improvements — severity sorting, progress bars, impact labels, and inline expandable guidance per check; (3) Supplier parent company grouping — collapsible group rows revealing consolidated spend across subsidiaries; (4) Overview annotated trend — period-average reference line on the monthly chart so anomalies are immediately visible. All changes are frontend-only.

decisions.recommendations_layout: Replace the Tabs UI with two new views above the cards: a lever summary strip (one card per lever showing total savings + count) and a savings composition bar chart. The individual recommendation cards remain below, filtered by the selected lever card. This gives composition overview at a glance before reading individual recommendations.
decisions.priority_matrix: Use Recharts ScatterChart for the priority matrix. Map confidence to numeric x-axis: HIGH=0.9, MEDIUM=0.6, LOW=0.3. Y-axis is estimated_impact_aud. ZAxis (bubble size) maps to addressable_baseline. Color each bubble by lever type using CHART_COLORS. A tooltip shows rec type, context, and impact on hover.
decisions.diagnostics_sort: Sort checks client-side RED→AMBER→GREEN using a severity score map. This is pure client-side ordering — no backend change.
decisions.diagnostics_guidance: Hardcode a CHECK_GUIDANCE map (check_name → { meaning, impacts, fix }) in DiagnosticsCheckCard. Clicking any non-GREEN card toggles an inline expanded section. No API call needed — guidance is static domain knowledge.
decisions.supplier_grouping: Group supplier rows by parent_company_name. Suppliers with no parent_company_name form an 'Independent Suppliers' group. Group header rows show group name, total group spend, subsidiary count — collapsible with useState. This uses the already-fetched supplierData array client-side, no new API calls.
decisions.reference_line: Add a ReferenceLine component (from recharts, already available) to SpendAreaChart when showReferenceLine prop is true. The reference value is computed as the mean of all total_spend values in the data array. Rendered as a dashed horizontal line with a label 'Avg'.
decisions.no_backend_changes: All enhancements are frontend-only. No new API endpoints required. All data is already available from existing queries.

existing_tables.transactions: Main fact table — all spend rows

userStories.title: Data Quality — inline expandable check guidance
userStories.description: Make each RED or AMBER diagnostics card clickable to expand inline guidance: what the check measures, what it impacts in the analysis, and concrete steps to fix it. Guidance text is hardcoded per check name — no API call required. GREEN checks are not expandable.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit file: frontend/src/components/dashboard/DiagnosticsCheckCard.tsx

Add a CHECK_GUIDANCE constant at the top of the file (outside the component): a Record<string, { meaning: string; impacts: string; fix: string }> covering all 9 check names: missing_supplier ('Transactions with no canonical supplier name matched. Impacts supplier consolidation recommendations and spend-by-supplier views. Fix: upload a supplier master file or manually map raw names in the Review Workstation.'), missing_category ('Transactions not assigned to a UNSPSC category after all 6 pipeline passes. Directly reduces recommendation coverage. Fix: add keyword rules in data/reference/keyword_rules.yaml or run the Review Workstation category queue.'), missing_gl_account ('Transactions with no GL account code. Reduces GL-based categorisation accuracy. Fix: ensure the source ERP export includes GL codes and re-ingest.'), missing_cost_centre ('Transactions with no cost centre or business unit. Limits spend-by-BU analysis. Fix: add cost centre column mapping during ingestion.'), low_confidence_category ('Categories assigned with confidence below 0.60. These are likely miscategorised. Fix: review low-confidence transactions in the Review Workstation and add overrides.'), low_confidence_supplier ('Supplier matches with confidence below 0.60. These may be incorrectly harmonised. Fix: review PENDING entries in the Review Workstation supplier queue.'), duplicate_transactions ('Potential duplicate invoice rows detected. Inflates spend totals. Fix: check source data for duplicate invoice numbers and re-ingest after deduplication.'), maverick_spend ('Spend without a purchase order on non-contracted suppliers. Indicates off-contract buying. Fix: enforce PO requirements and expand contract coverage.'), tail_spend_ratio ('Proportion of spend in low-volume tail suppliers. High tail spend increases admin cost and reduces leverage. Fix: consolidate tail suppliers to preferred vendors.')
Add optional prop onClick?: () => void and expanded?: boolean to DiagnosticsCheckCard

When status is 'RED' or 'AMBER', make the Card clickable: add onClick={onClick} and cursor-pointer className to the Card. Render a small ChevronDown/ChevronUp icon (h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground) in the top-right corner next to the Badge.

When expanded is true, render a div below the progress bar with className='mt-3 pt-3 border-t space-y-2 text-xs': show three rows labelled 'What it measures:', 'Impact:', 'How to fix:' each with their text from CHECK_GUIDANCE[check_name] ?? {meaning:'',impacts:'',fix:''}. Labels in font-medium, values in text-muted-foreground.

risks: Recharts ScatterChart ZAxis bubble sizing — the range=[40,400] controls pixel sizes, not data values. Test with a wide range of addressable_baseline values to ensure bubbles are not too large or invisible.
Recommendations page removes the Tabs import entirely — ensure no other component on the page still references TabsList/TabsContent or the build will error.

Supplier parent grouping: parent_company_name may be null for most suppliers, resulting in a very large 'Independent Suppliers' group. The group starts collapsed so this is fine visually, but test with datasets where most suppliers have no parent.

Progress component CSS selector '[&>div]:bg-amber-500' — this targets the inner div of shadcn Progress component. Verify the selector works with the installed shadcn version by checking frontend/src/components/ui/progress.tsx to confirm the inner element is a div.
outOfScope: Supplier sparkline column in the table (requires per-supplier monthly data — expensive to batch-fetch)
Cross-page active filter indicator dot on nav items
